projects.name: Leadly
projects.description: B2B SaaS platform that discovers and scores leads from Reddit.
highlights: Owned backend architecture, database schema, and REST APIs for a B2B SaaS that finds leads from Reddit, backed by PostgreSQL and Redis.

Built session-based authentication and security flows from scratch, including email/password login, email verification, Google OAuth, password recovery, and Redis rate limiting (user-level and IP-level).
Implemented background workers and scheduled jobs to fetch Reddit posts, score them, and match leads against customer profiles using AI providers.

Containerized backend, worker, and frontend services with Docker Compose, configured GitHub Actions CI, and self-hosted Coolify on an Ubuntu Linux VM on Oracle Cloud (OCI), pointing custom domains to the server IP and routing both Leadly and Coolify behind an Nginx reverse proxy.

projects.name: Emilia
projects.description: Open-source multipurpose Telegram bot for group moderation, spam control, music utilities, and multi-tenant bot cloning.
highlights: Built and maintained an open-source multipurpose Telegram bot for group moderation, spam control, and music utilities, used by 900K+ users across 5,900+ chats.
Added a bot-cloning system that lets users run their own independent bot instances (70+ active clones).
Improved query speeds and prevented abuse by implementing MongoDB database indexing, Redis caching, and rate limiting.
Self-hosted the bot in Docker containers managed through Portainer on an Ubuntu Linux VM on Oracle Cloud (OCI), with automated 24-hour database backups.
